notes.note: Clarry may have had 29 disposals but 22 of them were handballs. However he led the game in contested possessions with 17 and he had 6 clearances.  A great first season at the Giants.
23 disposals for Clarry but the wet and pressure impacted his efficiency which was down at 39%. First time this year he has had back to back scores under 100.

Oliver didn't have a big night with 14 of his 23 disposals being handballs. He also gave away 4 free kicks. This was his second lowest score of the season as Port again proved difficult to score against.
Clarry was one of the best for the Bombers despite giving away 4 free kicks. He led the team in Contested possessions with 15 and also clearances with 5.  He is having a great first season at GWS.
17 of his 23 disposals were handballs but he did add a game high 17 contested possessions and an equal game high 8 clearances.
Oliver was huge with 21 contested possessions and 9 clearances leading the game in both categories as he also had 36 disposals. A solid pick in your midfield if you need one.

Clarry was one of 7 Giants to go over 100 this week with 32 disposals and game highs in clearances with 10 and contested possessions with 17.  He has been up and down and we want him to put two big ones together now.

Oliver looked to have badly hurt a hamstring but he returned to the game as if nothing had happened as he posted 9 tackles and 24 disposals and a goal. Just watch injury reports this week in case it flares up.

Oliver was one that many looked at thanks to his great run of scoring that we have seen but this week he delivered his second lowest score of the season as his efficiency was held to 55% by the Carlton pressure.
Clarry continues to put up some good scores with this one being a great rebound from last game. 35 disposals and 8 clearances. He is one you can bring in.
Clarry amassed 28 disposals but 20 were by hand and he gave away 3 free kicks. This was his second lowest for the year. It was just the disposal efficiency of 75% that also hurt his score.

37 disposals and 8 tackles for Clarry but he added game highs with 23 contested possessions and 11 clearances which resulted in his biggest score of the season. With the Giants having the 'good' bye he could be a good option for you.
Clarry racked up 38 disposals and he led the game in both contested possessions and clearances with 24 and 12 respectively.
6 kicks with 30 handballs and 7 tackles. But he did give away 3 free kicks. This was just his second score under 100 and the first since round 1.
Clarry was fantastic with 32 disposals and a game high 9 clearances and equal game high 13 contested possessions. Still just the one score under 100 for him this season.
Clarry remains consistent and is scoring well. This is heading back to where Clarry was one of the best in the league. He has only had the one sub 100 game.
Oliver has really settled in to the Giants midfield. 18 contested possessions 9 clearances to go with 37 disposals.
Oliver had the 31 disposals and it makes it 4 over 100 from his five games now. He is really slotting into that Giants midfield now. Worth a look for you team.

Clarry was solid and has posted back to back 100+ for the first time this season but again the kick to handball ratio was 11 to 26 which can limit his scoring. However the game high 16 contested possessions and 9 clearances certainly outweighs that.
This is what we get from Oliver. Some up and down in his scoring. And this week represented what we were used to which was 9 kicks and 24 handballs.
Clarry was quiet for his second game in Giants colours but the team were well beaten so don't panic on him.
Clarry slotted in nicely at the Giants with a game high clearance tally in the game. Many weren't sure of how he would go but he was amongst the best on the ground.
